name: Clam Bait
summary: Mai'Lahii at Shadowprey Village has fished all his life and says the best bait is soft-shelled clam meat, which no fish can resist. He wants ten pieces, to be found around a wrecked ship up the coast to the north.

sections.title: The Best Bait
sections.body: Mai'Lahii has fished all his life, and he swears by soft-shelled clam meat as bait, since the fish cannot resist it. To the north, off the coast, lies a wrecked ship, and soft-shelled clams are scattered throughout that area. He asks for ten pieces of the meat.

sections.title: What Mai'Lahii Says
sections.body: Mai'Lahii says the witch doctor gave him exactly this advice for his headache: go fish, and he will feel better. He feels better already.

faq.answer: Mai'Lahii is a fisherman in Shadowprey Village on the Desolace coast. He has fished all his life.

faq.q: Where can the soft-shelled clams be found?
faq.answer: North of Shadowprey Village, around the wreck of a ship lying off the coast, where soft-shelled clams are scattered.

faq.q: Why does Mai'Lahii want clam meat?
faq.answer: He says soft-shelled clam meat is the best bait there is, and the fish cannot resist it.

faq.q: How much clam meat does Mai'Lahii want?
faq.answer: Ten pieces of the clam meat.
